# The maximal ideal of an Eisenstein extension of a DVR is generated by the root

Let $A$ be
a discrete valuation ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$, let $f \in A[X]$ be a monic polynomial
of positive degree that is Eisenstein with respect to $\mathfrak m$, and let $\alpha$ be the image
of $X$ in $A[X]/(f)$. If $A[X]/(f)$ is a local ring, then its maximal ideal is the principal ideal
$(\alpha)$.
